transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because I just don't really care about much anymore. Things I used to do, like... dance class, or hiking. Even just cooking new things or game nights with friends. It all just feels like a chore now. I just keep putting it all off.
Do you still enjoy things you used to, or has the pleasure gone away?

Yeah... like I was just saying. I don't really get anything out of them anymore. The things that used to make me feel like myself just... I don't know, the pleasure is gone, I guess. It's easier to just put it all off.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while. I guess it's been about two years and three months. Just... ever since the robbery. When I was working that festival job.
Do you feel sad or empty most of the time?
No... not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad. Or empty, I guess. I just... I don't know.
Do you still enjoy things, but just not as much, or do you not enjoy them at all?
I just... barely care about them at all. Like... dance class, or hiking... trying new recipes. Even game night. They just... they feel like chores now. I just keep putting them off.
Do you feel depressed?
I don't think so. I mean... I wouldn't call it depressed. Just... tired, maybe.
Do you feel anxious?
No... I don't think so. I don't really feel anxious. Just... I don't know.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't really been paying attention to it, but... I think it's about the same.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how quickly you move?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I guess I just move about the same as always.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's just... I don't know. Most days there's just this... this low, sour mix of fear and guilt kind of sitting under everything. Even when nothing bad is actually going on, it's... it's just there.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?
No. I... no, I haven't.
Have you ever thought about how you would harm yourself if you wanted to?
No. I... like I said, I haven't thought about doing that. So... no.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean... I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you often feel like you're worthless?
No. I... I don't really feel that way.
Do you often feel irritable?

Um... yeah, I guess. Just... little things set me off now. Like... if my mom asks about work, or... I don't know, a helper is just moving too slow. I just... I hear myself snapping at them before I can stop it.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or restless more often than you used to?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed being restless or anything.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better and were able to enjoy things a bit?

Not really. I just... I don't care much about things anymore. I used to go to dance class, or hike, or... try new recipes. Even game nights. But now... I don't know, they just feel like chores. I just keep putting them off.
Do you often think you're a bad person?
Um... no. I don't... I don't really think that. No.
Have you had any significant changes in your sleep patterns over the past two years?
Um... no, not really. I guess I sleep about the same as I usually do. I haven't noticed anything different.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that aren't really there?
No... I haven't. Nothing like that.
